This millet plot is small, only 0.10 hectare, and I am planting it together with cowpea as we always do here in the North. I will try to get some NPK and urea from the agro-dealer if the subsidized one comes, but I cannot afford much — maybe one bag to share across my plots. I will also spread the manure from my goats and sheep, because that is what keeps the soil alive. I use my own millet seed saved from last year, and my wife and children will help me with weeding; there is no money to hire people for such a small plot.
